description.value:
This obsidian staff is as black as ink, and tendrils of shadow writhe around it. While wielding this staff, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks while in dim light or darkness.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.

  • 1st @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Grim Tendrils]

  • 2nd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Darkness], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Darkvision], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Feral Shades]

  • 3rd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Blindness], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Shadow Projectile]

  • 4th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Darkness], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.Darkvision], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Incarnate Shadow Minuet]

  • 5th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Shadow Projectile], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Slither], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Umbral Journey]

  • 6th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Shadow Blast]

  • 7th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Incarnate Shadow Minuet], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Shadow Raid]

Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells.
